additions.description: The path JDWriter is mounted at behind a shared host, e.g. /jdwriter under CAES People (people.caes.ucdavis.edu/jdwriter). Leave unset to serve at the root. Add <host><path>/signin-oidc to the Entra app registration's redirect URIs when setting it.

Comma-separated UC Davis login IDs that are always JDWriter admins. They cannot be removed from the app, so the back end can never be left without an admin. Further admins are added in the app's Settings page.

Anthropic API key, used when LLM_PROVIDER is anthropic (the default). Store a Key Vault reference here (@Microsoft.KeyVault(SecretUri=...)) rather than the key itself; App Service resolves it. Where LLM_ALLOW_KEY_ENTRY_IN_APP is true, an admin may also enter a key in Settings, which is stored encrypted, audited, and takes precedence while set.
Which AI provider receives JD text: anthropic (default), azure-openai, or openai-compatible. An institutional choice made per environment; the app only reports it.
Model id (anthropic, openai-compatible) or Azure OpenAI deployment name. Optional for anthropic, which defaults to the model the prompts were tuned on.
Azure OpenAI resource endpoint (https://NAME.openai.azure.com) or an OpenAI-compatible base URL ending in /v1. Unused for anthropic.
Azure OpenAI REST API version. Defaults to 2024-10-21.
true only for reasoning-model deployments (o-series, GPT-5), which accept reasoning_effort; other models reject it.
false to manage provider keys in Key Vault only: Settings then shows the key's source but accepts no key. Defaults to true.
Azure OpenAI key, used when LLM_PROVIDER is azure-openai. Store a Key Vault reference (@Microsoft.KeyVault(SecretUri=...)) rather than the key itself.
Key for an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, when LLM_PROVIDER is openai-compatible and the endpoint needs one (a local model server usually does not).
HTTPS address of the workforce management tool (CTHULHU), linked from a finished JD's next steps. Leave unset until it has a production address; the steps are shown without a link.
